description: This file defines the 'Cart' component for a food delivery app, including UI for displaying cart items, total amount, persons count, and navigation to payment. It manages cart items, user interactions, and integrates with multiple BLoC providers for state management.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Main widget representing the shopping cart screen, integrating cart items with a stream builder based on CartListBloc.

classes.name: BottomBar
classes.description: Widget for displaying total amount, persons selection, and a navigation button to the payment page.

classes.name: CustomPersonWidget
classes.description: Stateful widget allowing the user to select the number of persons sharing the order.

classes.name: CartBody
classes.description: Container that displays the cart items list, header, and a title for the cart page.

classes.name: CartListItem
classes.description: Represents an individual food item in the cart, with drag-and-drop capabilities for item management.

classes.name: ItemContent
classes.description: Widget displaying the food item's image, quantity, title, and total price.

classes.name: CustomAppBar
classes.description: Custom top bar including back button and delete drag target.

classes.name: DragTargetWidget
classes.description: Widget allowing users to drag items to delete them from the cart.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the main widget structure for the cart, including stream handling.

methods.name: BottomBar
methods.description: Builds the bottom section with total, persons, and navigation.

methods.name: totalAmount
methods.description: Calculates and displays total cart amount.

methods.name: returnTotalAmount
methods.description: Calculates the sum of all food items' total prices.

methods.name: _CustomPersonWidgetState.build
methods.description: UI for incrementing or decrementing the number of persons.

methods.name: CartBody.build
methods.description: Builds the cart content including header and items list.

methods.name: foodItemList
methods.description: Generates the list view of cart items.

methods.name: CartListItem.build
methods.description: Builds each food item in the cart with drag-and-drop.

methods.name: ItemContent.build
methods.description: Displays a food item’s image, quantity, title, and price.

methods.name: CustomAppBar.build
methods.description: Builds the top app bar with back button and delete target.

methods.name: _DragTargetWidgetState.build
methods.description: Builds the delete target area for removing items.
